title: Republicans block impeachment attempt against Defense Secretary

slides.headline: Republicans block impeachment attempt against Defense Secretary
slides.subtitle: The effort to remove the Pentagon chief failed Tuesday.

slides.explanation: This vote effectively ends the current legislative challenge against the defense secretary. It mirrors the political intensity often seen during high profile cabinet oversight battles.

slides.headline: Hegseth had already dismissed the impeachment push
slides.explanation: Before the vote, the defense secretary publicly labeled the entire impeachment effort as a farce and a political stunt.
Five independent outlets including The Guardian and Al Jazeera confirm the details of this vote. This consistency shows exactly how the House handled the motion.

caption:
House Republicans have officially blocked an attempt to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

The move comes after critics alleged he violated the constitution regarding his handling of the Iran war.

Hegseth had previously dismissed the impeachment effort as a stunt. By rejecting the motion, the House has effectively cleared the path for him to continue his role without this specific legislative hurdle.

This decision highlights the sharp divide in how Congress views the administration's military oversight. Does this vote signal the end of impeachment efforts against this administration for now?
